# net-allowlist.txt -- existing offenders of the `net` class test in
# docs/SPEC-CI.md. One row: file:line kind date reason.
#
# The file only shrinks. An entry that names no offender on the tree is refused
# (`fix the host; the allowlist only shrinks`), so fixing a test means deleting
# its row in the same change, and a new row parks nothing. A row allows ONE
# offender of its kind in its file and is matched by file and kind, never by
# line, so a merge that shifts lines in a listed file does not turn dev red.
#
# These predate the checker. Each is a GitHub URL carried in a fixture, a fake
# gh stub, a fake git remote or a card template -- text handed to a fake, not a
# live unit-test endpoint. The allowed shape is httptest or a local fake.
